text_block_list.text: Christmas Day—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmaaas!!

text_block_list.name: All Four Heavenly Kings
text_block_list.text: "Merry Christmas!!"
Today, along with Bubble Gum Fellow, I was attending a Christmas party held at her former club.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, what do you think~?
Surprised at how big the party venue is, aren't you?
Our club is just that big, you know~?"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Why is Lapis looking so proud?
Besides, Trainer probably already knows the scale of our club anyway.
choice_data_list: Well, even so, I honestly thought it was impressive.

text_block_list.text:
The kids belonging to the club, and their guardians.
The staff running the club, and people who seem to be sponsors and stakeholders—

To be honest, I was a little overwhelmed
by the sight of so many diverse people gathering at the party.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I think almost everyone here knows who you are, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Wait, is that how it is!?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Bubble is the daughter of this club's owner, someone everyone here knows.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
And Trainer-san is the partner who pushed Bubble
to become the strongest of the era.
...There's no way you wouldn't know.

Hearing that makes me happy, but
at the same time, it makes me want to straighten my posture...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You'll be fine, Trainer.
Just do what you always do. Relax, relax!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go grab some food.
We probably won't have much time
to eat after this.

The meaning behind Bubble Gum Fellow's words
would become clear very soon after—

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
thank you very much for taking the time to come today.
Thank you for always taking care of my daughter.

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hearing about your training methods through my daughter,
as a club manager myself,
I have learned a tremendous amount from you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Father
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind,
would you give our club staff a brief opportunity
to speak with you?

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Father
text_block_list.text:
"There have been many, many requests
asking to hear from you directly—"
choice_data_list: If you're fine with me, of course I don't mind, but—

text_block_list.text: At that moment, I glance over at Bubble Gum Fellow.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go chat with Waltz, the others, and the coaches who've helped me out.
See ya later!
And so, Bubble Gum Fellow and I decided to go our separate ways for a while—

—By the time I finished being introduced to Bubble Gum Fellow's father and talking with various guests,
the party had already reached its halfway point...

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text: Both the Tenno Sho (Autumn) and the Japan Cup were masterfully handled...! What kind of things do you usually keep in mind during training—

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
My daughter wishes to enroll in Tracen Academy,
and she ardently hopes to receive guidance from a Trainer like you in the future—

...Everyone I spoke with today was brimming with passion,
and I was totally focused on responding to them with utmost sincerity.
Perhaps because of that, the moment we reached a stopping point, a wave of fatigue finally caught up with me...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ――Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, you must be tired, right? My dad had asked me
beforehand to let him have a word with you, Trainer, but—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea it would run this long.
Maybe I should have stopped it halfway through?
I was fortunate to learn just how much passion supports the club she grew up in.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Dad was
praising you a ton, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: She's sincere, passionate about her work, and cares so much about the Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Bubble is so lucky to have a Trainer like that
guiding her," they said.
choice_data_list: It's almost too good for me...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. About later—
would you mind keeping me company for a bit?
choice_data_list: Huh? Of course, that's fine, but—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Then let's get out of this party for now!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Waaah... The illuminations are amazing...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it really feels like Christmas...!
Yeah, it really feels like Christmas...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Waltz just told me earlier that they're doing an illumination display near the venue.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, I just thought
I really wanted to go see it with you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That's my line, you know?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "...You know how I mentioned earlier that my dad was really praising you, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Even I was surprised at myself back then, but—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...I was so, so happy.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
More than being praised myself,
seeing my Trainer get praised is what matters.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I was truly so proud... and so happy.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much
for making me feel this happy.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Let's look around a little more
before heading back.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Because then, every time we look at the illuminations,
we'll be able to remember this feeling.

I'll never forget this happiness welling up in my heart.
It became a Christmas that left a deep, lasting impression—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Let's look around a little more
before heading back.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Because then, every time we look at the illuminations,
we'll be able to remember this feeling.
choice_data_list: ...Then let's make it easier to remember.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Huh?
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: —Ah, Bubble-chaaan! Wanna go grab lunch now~?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Okay, count me in.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Bubble, did you always have a charm like that on your phone?

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー!
What's this? It's so cute~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Right? This is, you see—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—So that we can remember anytime.
They're matching.
